annotation.memory_content: Donald Smith is transitioning from a senior developer role in technology to political consulting, driven by a desire to support a relative's political career.
original_memories: Donald Smith's career_description is I work as a senior developer at Blockchain Tech, where I earn a substantial income. My role involves innovating new solutions and ensuring our technology remains cutting-edge. Despite my high earnings, I have limited savings because I frequently contribute financially to political campaigns and causes that support the politician I believe in. My career allows me to network with influential individuals who share my views.

original_target.old_proposition: Donald innovates technology as a senior developer and supports political causes financially.

My role involves innovating new solutions and ensuring our technology remains cutting-edge. Despite my high earnings, I have limited savings because I frequently contribute financially to political campaigns and causes that support the politician I believe in. My career allows me to network with influential individuals who share my views.

new_dialogue_evidence.quote: I've been thinking a lot about my career transition from technology to political consulting. It's a big change, but it feels like the right move to better support my relative's political ambitions.
The idea of directly advising political campaigns really excites me. I want to be more involved in shaping strategies that will help my relative win elections and establish a legislative legacy.
My problem-solving skills and experience in technology will help me analyze data effectively and develop impactful strategies.
I plan to use data analytics to understand voter patterns and tailor strategies that resonate with them. It's all about making informed decisions.

original_target.expected_new_state: Donald is transitioning toward political campaign strategy to support his relative, using technology/problem-solving experience.
original_target.allowed_modification_scope: Refine career duties/direction and motivation; preserve past experience, family goal and old historical facts.
